externalReference.summary: Playwright maintainers confirm that WebKit can misclassify new same-origin loads during document replacement as access-control errors and expose them as pageerror events. Their reproduced case uses XHR on Linux. The fix belongs in WebKit; that report does not establish the exact installed macOS build or clear this game receipt.

conclusion: The installed-engine fixture demonstrates that handled navigation-time Fetch refusals can produce this native diagnostic without game code. It supports a browser-lifecycle explanation for the game signature, but does not prove every historical native diagnostic shares that cause. No game workaround, browser-error exemption, deadline increase, strict-pass relabeling or new upstream issue/comment was made. Continue independent automated qualification; retain WebKit strict diagnostic gate as unresolved.
